Each share of Class B Common Stock held by the Reporting Person will automatically convert into one share of Class A Common Stock upon the sale or transfer of such share of Class B Common Stock, subject to certain exceptions, and in certain other circumstances described in the Issuer's amended and restated certificate of incorporation. Each share of Class B Common Stock is also convertible at any time at the option of the Reporting Person into one share of Class A Common Stock and has no expiration date.

The shares are held of record by Arvind Nithrakashyap, as Trustee of the Nithrakashyap/Chatterjee Revocable Trust, for which the Reporting Person serves as trustee and shares voting and dispositive power with his spouse.
